contexts.text: The sons straggled together in the midst of her () = combat. To struggle together = to combat. AE 710:21.
This collision or combat is treated of in this chapter...

Things which are repugnant are in collision, and then evil and falsity are punished; for in evil there is repugnance to good, and in falsity there is repugnance to truth; and as there is repugnance, there is also collision.
The gnashing of teeth = the collision of falsities with truths.
Opposite spheres collide with each other...
If the internal man afterwards denies what miracles have confirmed, there take place an opposition and collision of the internal and the external man.
Combats would be impossible without collisions of opposites...
When the falsity of evil approaches good, there arises a heat; and when it approaches truth, a collision.
I felt anxiety, arising from the collision of the spheres...
The interiors of those who live in such marriage, collide and combat with each other... The collision and combat of their interiors reveals itself after death...
The delights of these two loves collide together like enemies...
Clouds seen as it were colliding together. CL 415.

If the faith of the New Church were together with that of the former Church, there would be such a collision and conflict that everything of the Church with man would perish. General article. TCR 647.
